prompt: Schedule a 30-minute sync with Alex on Wednesday, respecting my core focus hours.
expected: Uses planning protocol, identifies core focus hours from constraints, avoids them, suggests an alternative slot on Wednesday and presents a dry-run command.
actual: Loaded planning-protocol.md and core-rules.md. Confirmed core focus hours. Suggested a 30-min slot at 14:00 (outside focus hours) and generated a dry-run command using gcalcli.

prompt: My flight was delayed by 3 hours. Please fix my schedule across Google Calendar and Apple Calendar for today.
expected: Uses calendar guard, identifies overlapping and impacted events across both calendars, proposes a merged repaired schedule with buffers, and asks for permission to execute.
actual: Loaded calendar_merge.py and calendar_guard.py. Merged events from both calendars, shifted all events down by 3 hours, identified 2 hard conflicts, and proposed a repaired schedule with a dry-run draft for approval.
